sources.snippet: ERNIE-Image-Turbo is an open text-to-image generation model developed by the ERNIE-Image team at Baidu. It is the distilled release of ERNIE-Image, built on the same single-stream Diffusion Transformer (DiT) family and designed for fast generation with strong fidelity in only 8 inference steps.
